prompt:
Hey — we're about to push our BurnCore supplement campaign live across TikTok, Meta, and our landing page. I've put all the draft copy into a single file at `campaigns/q3_launch/burncore_copy_for_review.txt`. It's aggressive right now (that was intentional for the draft), but before we send the creator brief and turn on paid ads, I need someone to go through everything properly and flag what's going to get us in trouble.

We only have internal pilot data (small, brand-funded, not peer-reviewed) and some customer testimonials — no published studies. The target market is the US.

Can you run a thorough pre-flight risk check on all the copy in that file and produce a written report saved as `ad_claim_risk_report.md`? I need it to actually be actionable — not just a list of 'this is risky' but with real alternatives we could actually run in ads. Include everything we need to make a go/no-go call before launch.
